title: Leap years
hints: Each rule in the definition needs at least one year that only that rule decides. A test with just `2024` cannot tell a correct `IsLeap` from one that only checks `% 4`.
Pick one year per rule: a normal year (`2023`), a leap year (`2024`), a century that is not leap (`1900`) and a 400th year (`2000`). Put them in a `[]struct{ year int; want bool }` and loop.
